notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
